Topic 2.1.9: The school

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The school. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify members of the (Head teacher, teachers, non-teaching 2. What is the importance school community staff and learners) of the school

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify members of the (Head teacher, teachers, non-teaching 2. What is the importance school community staff and learners) of the school
   In simple words: practise until you can identify members of the (Head teacher, teachers, non-teaching 2. What is the importance school community staff and learners) of the school. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The school using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The school in the examples.
2. Explain The school to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The school.
4. Show that you can: identify members of the (Head teacher, teachers, non-teaching 2. What is the importance school community staff and learners) of the school

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The school using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The school important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Outline the general community? school community importance of members of the school c) work together with members community of the school community 98 d) appreciate working together
2. Discuss their roles as with the school community members of the school community for sustainable interactions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify members of the (Head teacher, teachers, non-teaching 2. What is the importance school community staff and learners) of the school
